profile.subtitle: Computer Science Student
profile.description: I’m a Computer Science & Engineering student at Daffodil International University, passionate about software development, problem-solving, and AI technologies. I enjoy building practical digital solutions and continuously learning new technologies.

text: I’m Md. Arman Hossen, a Computer Science & Engineering student at Daffodil International University with a strong interest in software engineering and application development. I have a solid foundation in programming, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and mathematical problem-solving.

My strengths include logical thinking, analytical reasoning, writing structured code, debugging, and breaking complex problems into manageable solutions. I’m passionate about web development, building practical software applications, and exploring AI-powered technologies.
I continuously work to strengthen my technical skills, improve code quality, and develop efficient, maintainable, and user-focused solutions.
